summary: Put on the entity that server-controlled effects are attached to (born with ServerControlledEffectAttached). Holds the set of effect entities referencing it; ServerControlledEffectSystem removes the component when the set becomes empty.

fields.name: Effects
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1EAA800 zeroes a 48-byte hash set. Per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1EA7690 applies ReferenceChange entries (stride 0x60: added set at +0, removed set at +0x30) with FUN_14134cc00 (erase each 8-byte key, hashed by value % buckets) and FUN_14127e900 (insert), then removes the component when the key count at +0x2C is 0. macOS: ls::HashMap<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>, ecl::ServerControlledEffectSystem::ReferenceChange>. Live: buckets 5, one key.

open_questions: Keys assumed to be the effect entities' handles (8-byte keys, same map as Attached.AttachedTo); not checked against live key values.
